verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence covers performance, overclocking utilities and platform specs, none of which is an API reference. The passing mention of 'Ryzen AI Software For Developers' refers to a separate software offering, not a capability of this processor.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
